# r4np

The `r4np` package is the companion for the book [R For Non-Programmers
(R4NP)](https://r4np.com "R For Non-Programmers")

## Installation

Install this package straight from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("ddauber/r4np")
```

# Package index

## Functions

- [`install_r4np()`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/install_r4np.md)
  : Install and update all R packages used in the book
- [`create_project_folder()`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/create_project_folder.md)
  : Automatically create folders for a project
- [`ntest()`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/ntest.md) :
  Perform normality test for multiple variables at once
- [`ntest_by()`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/ntest_by.md) :
  Perform normality test for multiple variables by groups
- [`vtest()`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/vtest.md) : Test
  homogeneity of variance for multiple variables at once

## Datasets

- [`alcohol_2019`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/alcohol_2019.md)
  : Alcohol consumption around the world (2019)

- [`alcohol`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/alcohol.md) :
  Alcohol consumption around the world (2000-2019)

- [`comments`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/comments.md) :
  Student Life (Open comments)

- [`covid`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/covid.md) :
  COVID-19 DATA

- [`eqls_2011`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/eqls_2011.md) :
  European Quality of Life Survey Time Series (2011 only)

- [`eqls_country_2011`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/eqls_country_2011.md)
  : European Quality of Life Survey Time Series (2011 only, country
  aggregates)

- [`eqls`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/eqls.md) : European
  Quality of Life Survey Time Series, 2007 and 2011

- [`gep`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/gep.md) :

  Global Education Profiler *(random sample)*

- [`halloween`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/halloween.md) :
  Halloween

- [`hie_15_21`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/hie_15_21.md) :
  The Health Index for England (2015 and 2021)

- [`hie_2021`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/hie_2021.md) :
  The Health Index for England (2021)

- [`hie`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/hie.md) : The Health
  Index for England (2015-2021)

- [`ic_training`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/ic_training.md)
  : IC Training Data

- [`pplnat`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/pplnat.md) :
  People and Nature Survey for England, 2020-2023

- [`quest_time`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/quest_time.md)
  : Start and end dates/times of a questionnaire

- [`reading_time`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/reading_time.md)
  : Student Reading Time

- [`simpson`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/simpson.md) :

  Simpson's Paradox: A demonstration dataset *(random sample)*

- [`swm`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/swm.md) : Salary,
  Work experience, and Mindfulness (SWM)

- [`wvs_nona`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/wvs_nona.md) :

  World Value Survey *(Extract)*

- [`wvs_waves`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/wvs_waves.md) :
  World Value Survey (Waves)

- [`wvs`](https://ddauber.github.io/r4np/reference/wvs.md) :

  World Value Survey *(Extract)*
